hooks.command:
script="${SUPURR_CODEX_PLUGIN_HOOK:-}"; if [ -z "$script" ]; then script=$(find "$HOME/.codex/plugins/cache" -path "*/supurr/*/scripts/supurr-doctor-hook.py" -type f -print -quit 2>/dev/null); fi; if [ -z "$script" ] && [ -f "scripts/supurr-doctor-hook.py" ]; then script="scripts/supurr-doctor-hook.py"; fi; if [ -z "$script" ] && [ -f "plugins/supurr/scripts/supurr-doctor-hook.py" ]; then script="plugins/supurr/scripts/supurr-doctor-hook.py"; fi; if [ -z "$script" ]; then printf '%s
' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"Supurr plugin hook could not find supurr-doctor-hook.py. Reinstall or refresh the Supurr plugin."}}'; exit 0; fi; python3 "$script"
